## Discovery & Translational Science

- **[Biotech]** **[Anti-TREM2 antibody VHB937 demonstrates anti-inflammatory activity in microglia](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/43076885/)** — *PubMed*
  - Preclinical and clinical characterization of VHB937 showed that the antibody selectively targets the immunoglobulin-like fold (IgSF) domain of TREM2.
  - IgSF domain binding suppressed microglial inflammatory activity, supporting its therapeutic development for neurodegenerative conditions.

- **[De novo miniproteins selectively modulate CCR9 and ACKR4 via CCL25 targeting](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/43076896/)** — *PubMed*
  - De novo miniproteins engineered against the chemokine CCL25 demonstrated selective target engagement.
  - The miniproteins achieved selective suppression and biased signaling at chemokine receptors CCR9 and ACKR4.

- **[Mendelian randomization links lower NLRP3 activity to reduced coronary artery disease risk](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.11.20.26368563)** — *medRxiv*
  - A drug-target Mendelian randomization study constructed a genetic NLRP3 activity score using eight *cis*-*NLRP3* variants and systemic inflammatory markers (C-reactive protein, glycoprotein acetylation, and neutrophil count).
  - Genetically proxied attenuation of NLRP3 activity correlated with lower circulating IL-1β and IL-18 levels and predicted a significant reduction in coronary artery disease risk.

- **[Proteomic panel improves survival prediction in amyotrophic lateral sclerosis](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.07.20.26358511)** — *medRxiv*
  - High-depth Proximity Extension Assay proteomics of paired CSF (n = 244) and longitudinal serum (n = 851) samples from ALS patients identified survival-associated biomarkers, including CSF TPM3 and serum NEFL, peripherin, EDA2R, and CALCA.
  - An eight-protein serum signature incorporating NEFL, peripherin, EDA2R, and CALCA enhanced survival prediction beyond clinical parameters and NEFL alone (1-year AUC 0.89 vs. 0.84, p = 0.047).

- **[Synthetic ACTH(4-7)PGP analogue displays efficacy in mucopolysaccharidosis III models](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/43074484/)** — *PubMed*
  - Preclinical evaluation of ACTH(4-7)PGP, a synthetic peptide analogue of adrenocorticotropic hormone, demonstrated broad therapeutic activity across models of mucopolysaccharidosis III (Sanfilippo syndrome).

- **[Review highlights immunogenicity challenges in antibody-drug conjugate development](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/43075718/)** — *PubMed*
  - A technical review analyzes anti-drug antibody formation against ADCs, highlighting translational strategies to mitigate immunologic clearance and off-target toxicities.

## Early Trials — Phase I–II

- **[Biotech]** **[Kymera's oral STAT6 degrader demonstrates biologic-like efficacy in Phase 2 eczema trial](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/kymera-eczema-pill-phase2-data-protein-degrader-dupixent-ebglyss/875462/)** — *BioPharma Dive*
  - Kymera Therapeutics announced positive Phase 2 clinical trial results for its targeted protein degrader pill in patients with moderate-to-severe atopic dermatitis.
  - The oral agent achieved efficacy comparable to injectable biologics such as Sanofi and Regeneron's Dupixent, supporting its advancement as a potential oral alternative.

- **[Big Pharma]** **[Phase 1 trial evaluates dual GCGR/GLP-1R agonist survodutide in Chinese cohort with obesity](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/43074490/)** — *PubMed*
  - A Phase 1 trial evaluated the safety, tolerability, and pharmacokinetics of survodutide (a glucagon/GLP-1 receptor dual agonist) in Chinese participants with overweight or obesity.

- **[Imlifidase Phase 2 trial completed in Guillain-Barré Syndrome](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/43076475/)** — *PubMed*
  - A Phase 2 clinical study evaluated the safety and therapeutic activity of imlifidase, an IgG-degrading enzyme, in patients with Guillain-Barré Syndrome.

- **[Phase 2 study compares GnRH antagonists lumigolix and ganirelix in ovarian stimulation](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/43076476/)** — *PubMed*
  - A Phase 2 trial assessed the comparative clinical efficacy and safety of lumigolix versus ganirelix in controlled ovarian hyperstimulation for assisted reproductive technology protocols.

## Late & Pivotal Trials — Phase III

- **[Biotech]** **[Aficamten long-term extension data in oHCM shows low incidence of transient LV dysfunction](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.11.23.26360829)** — *medRxiv*
  - Long-term safety analysis of 410 patients in the FOREST-HCM open-label extension trial of aficamten (a cardiac myosin inhibitor) reported that left ventricular systolic dysfunction (LVSD, LVEF < 50%) occurred in 12 patients (2.9%; exposure-adjusted incidence rate 2.1 per 100 patient-years).
  - No patient developed LVEF < 40%, and all LVSD events were transient and managed with protocolized dose adjustments.

- **[REMAP-CAP trial finds no 90-day mortality benefit for cysteamine in severe CAP](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/43075557/)** — *PubMed*
  - The international REMAP-CAP adaptive platform trial evaluated adjunctive cysteamine in patients hospitalized with severe community-acquired pneumonia.
  - Treatment with cysteamine did not significantly alter 90-day all-cause mortality compared with standard care.

- **[PITSTOP trials evaluate prehospital fluids and antibiotics in suspected sepsis](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/43076208/)** — *PubMed*
  - The randomized PITSTOP factorial clinical trials evaluated prehospital administration of fluid resuscitation ([PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/43076208/)) and early antibiotics ([PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/43076168/)) versus standard care in patients with suspected sepsis.

- **[Sensitivity analysis of Phase 3 A4 trial confirms solanezumab effect estimates despite missing data](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.11.20.26368608)** — *medRxiv*
  - A reanalysis of 1,169 participants from the Phase 3 A4 trial of solanezumab in preclinical Alzheimer's disease evaluated baseline-to-Week-240 changes in PET Centiloids, PACC, and CDR-SB.
  - Applying inverse probability of censoring weighting to handle ~30% missing Week-240 data produced treatment effect estimates consistent with the primary trial analysis.

- **[Meta-analysis evaluates sildenafil for fetal growth restriction](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/43076474/)** — *PubMed*
  - An individual participant data meta-analysis examined clinical outcomes following sildenafil treatment in pregnancies complicated by severe fetal growth restriction.

## Regulatory & Approvals

- **[Big Pharma]** **[Roche wins second FDA clearance for oral SERD Wilserdly in early-stage breast cancer](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/fda-roche-wilserdly-breast-cancer-approval-early-stage/875563/)** — *BioPharma Dive*
  - The FDA approved Roche's oral selective estrogen receptor degrader (SERD) Wilserdly (inavolisib) for post-surgical adjuvant treatment of early-stage hormone receptor-positive breast cancer.
  - This marks the drug's second FDA clearance within a week, expanding its label following an initial approval in advanced breast cancer.

- **[Biotech]** **[FDA approves BridgeBio's Welgemda for limb-girdle muscular dystrophy](https://www.statnews.com/2026/11/23/fda-approves-bridgebio-lgmd-drug-welgemda/)** — *STAT News*
  - The FDA approved BridgeBio's Welgemda, establishing the first targeted pharmacotherapy for limb-girdle muscular dystrophy.
  - Clinical trial data demonstrated functional improvements in ambulation and respiratory parameters, with commercial pricing expected near $1 million annually.

- **[Biotech]** **[FDA accepts TG Therapeutics' sBLA for single-dose initiation of Briumvi](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2125205651005804837)** — *X (@BioStocks)*
  - TG Therapeutics announced FDA acceptance of its supplemental Biologics License Application (sBLA) for a simplified single-dose initiation schedule for Briumvi (ublituximab-xiiy).
  - The FDA set a PDUFA target action date of July 10 for the sBLA decision.

- **[FDA cites two drugmakers for failing to report trial results to ClinicalTrials.gov](https://www.statnews.com/pharmalot/2026/11/24/fda-cites-two-drugmakers-for-failing-to-report-clinical-trial-results/)** — *STAT News*
  - The FDA issued formal notices of non-compliance to two pharmaceutical companies for failing to submit required clinical trial data to ClinicalTrials.gov.
  - The regulatory action represents the agency's first public enforcement citations for trial result reporting non-compliance in over a year.

- **[Biotech]** **[Invivyd outlines accelerated approval pathway for VYD2311](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2125011846088282349)** — *X / BioStocks*
  - Cantor reports that Invivyd ($IVVD) has established a regulatory pathway with the FDA toward accelerated approval for VYD2311.
  - The filing strategy relies on trial data from the DECLARATION and LIBERTY studies, with full vaccine efficacy readouts to be provided post-approval (unconfirmed analyst commentary).

## Business & Strategy

- **[Big Pharma]** **[Sanofi acquires Insmed for $41B in year's largest biopharma acquisition](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/sanofi-insmed-acquisition-deal-immunology-rare-disease/875627/)** — *BioPharma Dive*
  - Sanofi ($SNY) entered into a definitive agreement to acquire U.S. biotech Insmed ($INSM) for $41 billion in cash at $175 per share ([X / BioStocks](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2125126300449054921)).
  - The acquisition grants Sanofi two approved commercial therapies for rare pulmonary conditions alongside Insmed's late-stage immunology pipeline.

- **[Big Pharma]** **[Eli Lilly shifts M&A focus toward oncology](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2125020629502193894)** — *X / BioStocks*
  - Business development leadership at Eli Lilly ($LLY) indicated the company is prioritizing cancer acquisitions, having deployed more than $20 billion toward M&A this year compared to roughly $4 billion in 2025.

- **[Biotech]** **[Kymera Therapeutics prices $1.75 billion public offering](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2125061540177125627)** — *X / BioStocks*
  - Kymera Therapeutics ($KYMR) priced an offering of 11.63 million shares at $150.37 per share to raise $1.75 billion in gross proceeds.

- **[Biotech]** **[DiaMedica Therapeutics prices $86 million offering](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2125196954535854309)** — *X / BioStocks*
  - DiaMedica Therapeutics ($DMAC) announced the pricing of an $86 million stock offering at $8.00 per share.

## Public Health & Policy

- **[CMS projects $9.2B in savings from third round of Medicare drug price negotiations](https://www.statnews.com/2026/11/23/medicare-drug-price-negotiations-announcement-third-round/)** — *STAT News*
  - Federal health officials released projections indicating $9.2 billion in annual Medicare savings under the third round of negotiated drug prices.

- **[U.S. menopause hormone therapy prescriptions surge 141%](https://www.statnews.com/2026/11/24/health-news-menopause-hormone-therapy-med-popularity-increases-141-percent/)** — *STAT News*
  - U.S. prescription audit data show a 141% increase in menopause hormone therapy dispensing compared to prior years.
  - In June 2026, 4.9 million hormone therapy prescriptions were dispensed to cisgender women aged 40–74.

- **[Longitudinal study confirms persistent HBV immunity 10 years after pediatric vaccination](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/43075717/)** — *PubMed*
  - A 10-year prospective study of children vaccinated against hepatitis B virus in infancy with hexavalent or pentavalent vaccines showed waning surface antibody levels (anti-HBs) without serological evidence of breakthrough HBV infection up to age 10.

**Worth watching:** Kymera's $1.75 billion capital raise following positive Phase 2 STAT6 degrader data signals strong investor confidence in oral targeted protein degradation competing directly with major injectable biologics.

- Biology & Health
    - [Best Blood Pressure lowering Exercise just got Better](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/vvG9yCmFeRE) -- Physionic
        - A network meta-analysis of 270 randomized controlled trials demonstrated that isometric exercise, particularly wall squats, produces blood pressure reductions often exceeding 6–10 mmHg.
        - A subsequent randomized controlled trial showed that three weekly sessions reduced systolic blood pressure by over 10 mmHg, while maintaining one or two sessions per week preserved reductions of 5–6 mmHg following an initial training period.
        - The effective wall-squat protocol consists of four 2-minute holds interspersed with 2-minute rest intervals, totaling 14 minutes per session.
        - Results are limited by the study's short 8-week duration and cohort of generally younger adults, leaving long-term benefits uncertain.
    - [The Founder Is the Moat](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/XqolXRlFbAA) -- Health2Tech
        - Bret Waters asserts that technology is no longer a startup's strongest competitive advantage or moat.
        - A startup's primary moat relies directly on the founder rather than proprietary technical capabilities.
        - Key founder-driven differentiators include unique domain insights, established industry relationships, and a distinct point of view.
- Economics
    - [Pourquoi la France emprunte-t-elle aussi cher ?](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4SIjD0S7gEE) -- Heu?reka
        - France's market borrowing rate has reached 5.00%, making it the highest in Europe and exceeding rates of countries such as Greece at 4.40%.
        - The analysis evaluates French macroeconomic conditions, structural drivers of the public deficit, and effective interest rates on state debt.
        - It examines market reactions, potential sanctions from financial markets, and political implications surrounding the 2027 election.
        - The video questions prevailing financial ideology and considers whether fiscal adjustment is possible without reducing public services.
